title: ulmaria pentapetala var. glauca
intro: Ulmaria pentapetala var. glauca, commonly known as a variant of the Marsh Valerian, is a perennial herb belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its calming and soothing properties. The therapeutic actions of Ulmaria pentapetala var. glauca include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valerenic acids, valeranone, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
